core.description: First-impression studio routes with an evidence-backed strict floor above the global minimum.

catalog.description: Broad catalog and navigation routes with heavier generated/catalog surfaces.

trust.description: Conversion, contact, rank, and proof routes where credibility must stay high.

analytics.description: Public measurement and article-engagement surfaces; mobile performance must remain at or above 90.

longtail.description: Lab-volatile homepage or generated/archive-like routes. Explicit floor, never implicit exemption. A single-run floor breach is downgraded to advisory ONLY when the committed trend ledger corroborates an above-floor recent median; a persistent (trend-confirmed) breach still hard-fails.
